description: Green Co-Financing Loans: To provide favorable terms for investment loans to SMEs that develop Green Transition projects.
programme_objective: To support SMEs in developing Green Transition projects and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, protect the environment, and lower energy consumption costs.
eligible_parties: Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) with a legitimate establishment and operation in Greece
property_requirements: The loan amount cannot exceed €8 million
The first repayment period must be completed by June 30, 2026
funding_coverage: 40% of the loan amount (from the Fund) and 60% from the Hellenic Bank Group
energy_performance_targets: Energy performance targets for the Green Transition projects
eligible_interventions: Green Transition projects in the sectors of Green Mobility, Energy Efficiency, and Renewable Energy
application_process: KYC platform (Know Your Customer) and the Hellenic Bank Group's website
